algorithm_boundary.control: On the first NS0024 edge, exactly six of 140 parent root lines survive, 134 die, no nonzero affine layer contributes a root, and the survivors have type 3A1+A2.
algorithm_boundary.not_proved: No completeness or complexity bound for finding a line satisfying a prescribed ADE target, elliptic-neighbour interpretation, equation lift, or field of definition is claimed.
algorithm_boundary.proved: For fixed positive even K,C,H and a good odd-prime line, the displayed modular incidences plus finite affine-CVP shells determine the complete child root metric before constructing the child lattice.

compiled_line_constraints.birth_constraints: For every graph class (a,b), bridge vector c in C^dual+b, and 0<=j<p, enumerate M+r_a+k0+j*y/p at norm 2-c^2.
compiled_line_constraints.exclusion_constraint: Every other joined affine shell of total norm two is empty.
compiled_line_constraints.target_metric_constraint: The complete joined witness set must have the prescribed pairwise metric of 3A1+A2.
